tei:div.tei:p: (nya)༄༅// tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhugs// ༄༅// rje btsun rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo// tshogs kyi mchod pa mdor bsdus byed par 'dod na/ dang po sngon 'gro la/ gnas/ dus/ rten bsham pa/ mchod rdzas so// de la dang po gnas khang phyag dar byas/ chag chag gdab/ maṇḍal dang me tog dgram/ thang sku dgram pa la sogs pa byas/ gnyis pa dus ni tshogs bsog par 'dod pa la mar gyi tshes bcu/ sgrib pa zad par 'dod pa la mar gyi tshes bcu la bya'o// gsum pa rten ni sindhū ra'i dkyil 'khor ram/ me long la chang gis chos 'byung bri/ dbus su me tog gcig bzhag go /bzhi pa mchod pa ni/ me tog bdug pa mar me gsum g.yon du/ dri dang lha bshos gtor ma gsum g.yas su'o// chang phud ni mdun du bsham/ tshogs kyi yo byad ni ci 'byor ba bsham mo// de nas cho ga la 'jug pa ni/ slob mas maṇḍal byas te zhu ba 'bul/ thams cad kyi thugs dgongs mthun par bya/ de nas bla ma la tshad mar 'dzin pa dang*/ bdag nyid la tshad mar 'dzin pa ste/ rje btsun mar bskyed la sku mdog la sogs pa gsal gdab/ de nas bsdus pa yin pas sngags ci nus bzlas pas mchod do// lte bar zla ba la oṃ bam̐ dmar mo phag mo/ snying gar ham̐ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ mgrin par hriṃ mam̐ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ spyi bor hreṃ hriṃ ser mo skrag byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu skrod byed ma/ yan lag la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇḍi kar mos pa bya/ de nas grub na mchod pa lngas mchod/ ma grub na mi dgos/ de nas gtor ma la 'bru gsum bzlas/ dur khrod brgyad la sogs pa tshim par bya/ de nas tshogs kyi yo byad la 'bru gsum bzlas la bdud rtsir bsams la phud dbul/ de nas lha mchod pa'i bsam pas longs spyad/ de nas sems tshim pa'i yan lag tu glu dang gar la sogs pa bya/ bkra shis brjod/ smon lam ni/ lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*// des gsungs tshig brjod mchog tu tshad ma ste// bden pa de dag gis ni bdag cag rnams// rtag tu rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig
/lhag ma bsdus la u tstshiṣṭas btang*/ go cha bcing ngo*// las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o//

༄༅// yang tshes bcu'i mchod chung bzhugs// ༄༅// bla ma dam pa dang rnal 'byor ma tha mi dad pa la phyag 'tshal lo// rnal 'byor pas tshes bcu'i mchod pa yi dam du byed na/ tsandan dmar po lag pa g.yon pas chos byung gi maṇḍal gru gsum du byugs/ tsandan med na chang gis byugs/ der me tog tshom bu dgod/ de'i steng du rje btsun ma rdzogs tshul du bsams la dngos su mchod pa lnga dbul/ med na sngags dang ting nge 'dzin gyis dbul/ yan lag bdun pa bya/ tshad med pa bzhi bsgom/ grub na maṇḍal gyi steng du me long la sindhū ra dar tshags kyis btab/ lag pa g.yon pas chos 'byung nyis brtsegs legs par bris pa'i mdun rgyab bor pa'i zur bzhi la/ dga' ba 'khyil pa bzhi bri/ dbus su sarba buddha la sogs pa bris la sngags dang lha tha mi dad pas mchod pa la sogs pa sngar dang 'dra/ bshags pa bya/ tshad med pa ni sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang bral bar bya snyam pa ni byams pa/ bde ba dang phrad par bya snyam pa ni snying rje/ bde ba de rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par bya snyam pa ni dga' ba/ 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad bral ba ni btang snyoms/ de nas sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho zhes pa nas gtor ma yan chad bsgom/ de nas rnal 'byor pas tshogs mchod bya/ de nas ma grub na yar dang mar gyi tshes bcu la bu mo grong ba'i chos kyis ma gos pa gsum mam/ lnga bza' btung gis tshim par byas/ de yang ma grub na snying po brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas so// nyams pa thams cad 'dag gsung*/// / ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
